failure_modes: Time-conditioned regional attention (C008-C011) reweights observed score nodes without a validated spatial gradient, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates and secondary strain.
Dose edits (C001-C003) change pointcloud_delta_A with no evidence of expected affinity advantage over the incumbent default of 1.0 A.
Teacher-neighbor edits (C005-C007) alter the detached nearest-k prior count without endpoint evidence supporting a change from the incumbent k=4.
Interpreting the non-monotone temporal derivative as a spatial gradient would misdirect coordinate control; no absolute affinity target is available from the supplied observations.
rationale: D1.2: The offered time-conditioned alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009-C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change regional attention at observed score nodes or blend the static reward with an observed-teacher reward; they do not change teacher coordinates, and they are not dose-only edits. The Analyst's temporal evidence (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1) shows non-monotone landmark mass with large opposing first/last rate z-scores, no accepted polynomial and extrapolation disallowed, so a time-conditioned rule is only defensible as observed-node interpolation, not as a stationary coordinate target. The endpoint contrasts (Ecbb36ef90768cba0, E3114d60bf4cd5720) are signed coordinate contrasts at the observed endpoint, not trajectory velocity forces, and the clocks observation (E0857891f4effbfe1) confirms recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity target is available. D4.1: The incumbent (teacher_neighbors=4, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, static endpoint pointcloud reward) already sits at the registered default dose and neighbor count; the offered edits are either dose changes (C001-C003) or attention/teacher changes (C004-C011) with no evidence of a defensible expected affinity advantage over the incumbent. The evidence therefore does not change the decision away from retaining the incumbent. D4.2: The predicted failure of a temporal or regional attention edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the non-monotone landmark mass and local derivative sign changes (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1) mean a time-conditioned attention weight would reweight regions at observed nodes without a validated spatial-gradient basis, risking drift of neighboring coordinates and secondary strain while the primary affinity objective is unproven. Under the affinity-first priority, retaining the incumbent avoids that failure mode.
